demonstrated_definition: True means the immutable candidate contains the stated source support, generated artifact and executable check. It is not a claim that a deployment or external URL currently passes. Run identifiers, timestamps, results and promotion status belong only in an independently signed promotion envelope or freshness receipt outside the candidate.

evidence: Weighted preferred names, identifiers, alternatives and bounded typo correction with explanations
Search shards are independently digest-bound so a vocabulary-only correction need not rebuild unrelated data
Exact precomputed distributions for designation, grade, geography, date, source and risk fields
limitations: Not every field applies to every category or year

evidence: Source layers and annual event types project to explicit record and heritage types
Official NHLE rich page, exact HAR register search, source feature, annual workbook and frozen geometry resources
limitations: A HAR annual row binds its List Entry Number to the official search endpoint and does not invent the live register's opaque item ID

evidence: Boundary membership, HAR-to-NHLE and annual-continuity assertions carry predicates, evidence and authority
YAML-LD is the authoring representation; the normalized semantic graph and its semantic plane root define graph identity
limitations: Annual continuity is visibly normalized, not source-declared

evidence: The Links plane projects governed relationship types and source/target routes from the same filtered record set
Stable intents are sharded by the SHA-256 of each canonical URL; changing a link touches only its shard and dependent checks
limitations: A link is not evidence of legal effect unless its assertion metadata says so
External availability is a time-bounded observation recorded outside the candidate

evidence: Designation, amendment and annual register dates drive the same filtered result set
limitations: Different categories use different statutory date meanings

evidence: Source geometry shards, exact scope memberships and labelled polygon representative points
The Narrative plane explains how every view remains a projection of one evidence-bound query and facet state
limitations: Generated narrative explains the evaluation and does not reproduce Historic England rich-page prose

evidence: Selected record exposes source values, normalization, identifiers, geometry, quality and links
Snapshot, request, source object or workbook row, relationship evidence and assertion labels
limitations: Source provenance is not an independent factual audit

evidence: The faithful journey requires one query and facet state to survive view changes, Back, Forward and reload
The tiny journey and visual contracts require keyboard-reachable controls, semantic labels, live result summaries, reduced-motion behavior and HVR001/HVR002 viewport coverage
limitations: Automated checks complement but do not replace assistive-technology user testing

evidence: A separate publication unit owns the rooted faithful, tiny and synthetic corpus while OKF Explorer remains the reusable runtime
The candidate carries per-plane roots, a manifest-owned file inventory, HTML-reading-page requirements and an executable publication journey
Promotion requires an independently signed envelope binding the exact candidate, deployed descriptor, plane roots, browser results and release identity
limitations: Candidate capability does not assert that Pages or an external source URL currently works
Live-link freshness receipts and deployment observations expire independently and remain outside the candidate
Publication success does not turn this evaluation into a legal register or make Historic England source claims independently assured

publication_boundary: The faithful corpus is an evaluation projection, not a legal register; the synthetic bundle is separately identified, default-off and excluded from faithful counts and search. Promotion and link-freshness observations are independent evidence and do not mutate the candidate.
